title: Female genital mutilation
reading: Female genital mutilation, or female circumcision, is a procedure that damages or removes the outer genital parts for non-therapeutic reasons. It is considered female genital mutilation regardless of the extent of damage etc. Female genital mutilation is illegal in Norway. Female genital mutilation is harmful and can afflict the girl for the rest of her life.

Equality between the sexes is an important value in Norwegian society. It is a matter of course that everyone can decide over their own bodies. Female genital mutilation violates these values. It also violates international conventions. It is illegal too in some countries where it is practised.
discussion: Talk together Why is there a tradition of circumcising girls in some cultures? What can different groups do to bring an end to this tradition? How can the strict rules in Norway prevent girls being circumcised?
exercises: Select the right answer What is female genital mutilation? a procedure that damages or removes the external genitalia for non-therapeutic reasons. a procedure that damages or removes the external genitalia for therapeutic reasons. Select the right answer How many years’ imprisonment can you get for aggravated female genital mutilation? 6 years 10 years 15 years Select the right answer How long a prison sentence can you get for breach of the duty to avert? 1 year 2 years 3 years Complete the sentence If a girl or woman consents to circumcision, the procedure … is still illegal. is not a criminal offence. is legal. Select the right answers Female genital mutilation is harmful and can afflict a girl for the rest of her life. Equality between the sexes is an important value in Norwegian society. Female genital mutilation is permitted in Norway in certain instances. It is legal to take a girl out of Norway and impart harm on her genitals. It is illegal to restore or reconstruct earlier female genital mutilation.
